messages:
incbot: INCIDENT ALERT • Region eu-west-1 • p99 streaming latency spike on /v1/stream > 5.2s (SLO breach) — affected routes: chat-stream, convo-proxy. Triggered at 2026-03-14T10:34:27Z. Paging mike_oncall for triage.

sara_ops: seeing the same in console — multiple p95/p99 jumps coincident with a calibrations rollout. I think this is the fp8/int8 mixed precision calibration we rolled at 10:10.

mike_oncall: on it. grabbing initial perf graphs. can someone post the deploy id for the calib job?

sara_ops: deploy id: calib-2026-03-14-17:10-fp8-mix. Just pushed to eu-west-1 pool.

mike_oncall: looking at traces — streaming stalls look like KV cache miss storms plus dequant steps. p50 ok, p95 ~ 600ms, p99 ~ 5200-6800ms on some instances.

jordan_sre: paging in — I can take handoff in 20m. If we can confirm rollback plan, I'll execute.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback precision profile on eu-west-1 to last-known-good (fp8-mix → fp8-legacy), 2) route streaming traffic to eu-central-1 fallback pool, 3) enable aggressive prefix/KV caching and reduce batch sizes for streaming. planning to try 1 then 2 if not improved.

lia_cx: lia_cx here — we've identified 12 customers with streaming SLAs that hit errors/long tails. Need timeline and customer-facing note.

eng_runtime_lead: quick note: the new calibration increased dequant ops when sequence-lengths > 1024 due to an extra cast path. It wasn't hitting in perf tests for short sequences. Rolling back should restore previous kernel path.

mike_oncall: will attempt rollback now. using deploy_bot rollback command.

deploy_bot: @mike_oncall received rollback request: rollback calib-2026-03-14-17:10-fp8-mix -> fp8-legacy. Starting canary rollback to 2 nodes in eu-west-1. ETA ~ 3m.

mike_oncall: posting quick logs showing spike around rollout:
```
[2026-03-14T10:12:04Z] route=/v1/stream instance=gw-12 p99=420ms p95=120ms
[2026-03-14T10:15:21Z] route=/v1/stream instance=gw-12 p99=980ms p95=150ms
[2026-03-14T10:34:26Z] route=/v1/stream instance=gw-42 p99=5.3s p95=620ms
[2026-03-14T10:36:03Z] route=/v1/stream instance=gw-42 stall="dequant_kv_wait"
```

mike_oncall: can we also temporarily throttle non-SLA endpoints on streaming to protect customers? suggestion: drop to 50% QPS for demo/low-tier keys.

sara_ops: we can add a rate-limit rule on the gateway, will push rule now.

sara_ops: pushed temporary rate-limit: if plan in [free, trial] then qps *= 0.5 — applied to eu-west-1.

deploy_bot: rollback canary healthy on node gw-42, metrics trending down. continuing rollback to remaining nodes.

mike_oncall: after canary we see p99 back to ~340ms on canary nodes. propagating full rollback.

eng_runtime_lead: confirm that rollback toggles kernel selection back to quant-path-v2 which avoids the extra cast. That should fix the KV dequant contention.

lia_cx: lia_cx — drafting customer note: short apology, root cause: calibration rollout causing increased dequant latencies for long-context streaming; mitigation: rollback and routing; impacted customers list and timeline. Will share draft in ~10m.

jordan_sre: taking handoff now — I'll stay on until metrics stable for 1 hour. mike, anything you want me to follow up on?

mike_oncall: please validate p99/p95 across the eu-west tier and confirm no regression in cost/throughput. also validate that the fallback routing rules are disabled.

eng_runtime_lead: I'm opening a follow-up task to add unit tests that simulate long-context streams with the new calibration path. Also scheduling a canary window with smaller traffic for future rollouts.

deploy_bot: full rollback complete on eu-west-1 at 2026-03-14T10:46:14Z.

incbot: Update: Incident=INC-2631234567 • Status=Mitigated • Mitigation=rollback precision profile to fp8-legacy; rate-limited non-SLA streaming; canary+full rollback completed. p99 back to 360ms. Pages closed.

mike_oncall: metrics look stable: p95=180ms, p99=370ms for /v1/stream across eu-west-1. no increases in error rate. marking incident mitigated.

lia_cx: sent customer notes to affected accounts; some asked for postmortem and timeline — I'll collect and attach logs.

jordan_sre: leaving on-call in 30m — I will keep watch for any aftershocks but handing chest to followup owners.

eng_runtime_lead: root cause summary for postmortem: precision calibration introduced a dequant cast path that increases KV cache contention on long-context streaming. Regression escaped canary due to synthetic load not covering >1024 token sequences. Action items: (1) improve long-context canaries, (2) add perf regression tests for dequant/KV path, (3) add rollout guard to delay mixed-precision calibration by region with a gradual ramp, (4) customer comms.

mike_oncall: converting to postmortem task (PM-263123) and assigning to eng_runtime_lead + sara_ops + lia_cx. Closing thread, will attach graphs and logs in the postmortem doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
